name: hanumant-seva
description: Hanumant Seva — runs Backend (Express) + frontend (Vite) together

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix frontend
